title: Cacik Yogurt Cucumber Dip

seo.title: Cacik Recipe: Authentic Turkish Yogurt Cucumber Dip
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make authentic Turkish Cacik, a refreshing yogurt cucumber dip. Perfect for mezze or as a side. Get the easy recipe with simple ingredients!

seo.imageAlt: A bowl of authentic Turkish Cacik yogurt cucumber dip, garnished with fresh dill and olive oil, ready to serve.
seo.imageCaption: Cool, creamy, and utterly refreshing: our homemade Cacik Yogurt Cucumber Dip is a Turkish delight!

description: Cacik is a classic Turkish yogurt and cucumber dip, known for its incredible refreshing qualities. Made with strained yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, dill, and a hint of olive oil, it is the perfect accompaniment to grilled meats, pilaf, or as part of a traditional mezze spread. Its cool and tangy flavor makes it an indispensable part of Turkish cuisine, especially during warmer months.

instructions.title: Prepare the Cucumbers
instructions.text: Wash, peel, and grate the cucumbers using the coarse side of a box grater. Place the grated cucumber in a clean kitchen towel or cheesecloth and squeeze out as much excess water as possible. This step is crucial to prevent the cacik from becoming watery.

instructions.title: Mince Garlic and Chop Herbs
instructions.text: Peel and finely mince or crush the garlic cloves. Finely chop the fresh dill. If using, have your dried mint ready.

instructions.title: Combine Main Ingredients
instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, add the strained yogurt. Add the squeezed grated cucumber, minced garlic, chopped fresh dill, and salt to taste. Mix gently until all ingredients are well combined.

instructions.title: Adjust Consistency with Water
instructions.text: Gradually add cold water, about 1/2 cup to 1 cup, stirring continuously, until you reach your desired consistency. Some prefer a thicker dip, while others like it thinner, similar to a cold soup. Taste and adjust salt if needed.

instructions.title: Chill for Best Flavor
instructions.text: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 35 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the cacik to chill thoroughly. This resting time significantly enhances the taste.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: Before serving, give the cacik a final stir. Ladle it into individual serving bowls or a large communal dish. Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil. Garnish with a sprinkle of dried mint, a sprig of fresh dill, or a few cucumber slices. Serve immediately with fresh bread, grilled meats, or as part of a mezze platter.

tips: For the most authentic Cacik, always use full-fat strained yogurt (süzme yoğurt). Its thick, creamy texture is essential and prevents the dip from becoming too thin.
Properly squeezing excess water from the grated cucumber is critical. If left watery, it will dilute the yogurt and make the cacik less flavorful and runny.
Cacik tastes even better after chilling for at least 30 minutes to an hour. This allows the flavors of garlic, dill, and cucumber to fully meld with the yogurt.
